title: Crisp Cassava Fries
description: A tasty and crunchy side dish made with cassava. Perfect for snacking or as a side to your favorite meal.
instructions: Peel the cassava and cut it into fry shapes.
Soak the cassava in water for at least 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Carefully add the cassava fries to the hot oil in batches.
Fry the cassava fries for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the fries from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Sprinkle the salt, pepper, and nutmeg over the fries.
Note: To make crispy cassava fries, it's essential to not overcrowd the pan and to fry them in batches.
